doc: The hits of one search: where a reader sees each, and where an editor would change it.

envelope.doc: The header, ahead of the first hit.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: VERSION. A reader that does not know it stops.

fields.name: bookCount
fields.doc: Books SEARCHED, whether or not they matched: the id table's length.

envelope.doc: One hit: where a reader sees it, and where an editor would change it.
One searched book's id length in bytes, in id-table order.
One hit's preview length in bytes, index-aligned with the hits.

envelope.bytes: sum of idByteLen, then sum of previewByteLen
envelope.doc: Every id's UTF-8 in order, then every preview's; after the lengths so every u32 stays aligned.

records.name: Hit
records.doc: One hit: where a reader sees it, and where an editor would change it.

fields.name: bookIndex
fields.doc: Into the buffer's own id table, which names every book SEARCHED.

fields.name: projectedFrom
fields.doc: First unit of the hit in the PROJECTION — what a highlighter wants.

fields.name: pieceCount
fields.doc: Source pieces below; more than one where the hit crosses masked markup.

records.name: Piece
records.doc: One contiguous source piece of a hit, in the raw book's UTF-16.

fields.name: sourceFrom
fields.doc: First unit of the piece in the SOURCE — where an edit lands.

records.name: IdLen
records.doc: One searched book's id length in bytes, in id-table order.

fields.name: idByteLen
fields.doc: Bytes of UTF-8 in the blob at the end of the buffer.

records.name: PreviewLen
records.doc: One hit's preview length in bytes, index-aligned with the hits.

fields.name: previewByteLen
fields.doc: Bytes of UTF-8 in the blob at the end of the buffer.
